# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces: 3 tokens; Text: 3 tokens; Palette ramps and brand: 55 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing: 12 tokens; Radius: 5 tokens; Shadow: 3 tokens; Size: 11 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--page);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `page` | #f8fafc | Main palette · the paper: the page ground behind every card. It is also the token you use for that ground, `bg-page`. If you change it, keep the text colours below readable on it. Tailwind default: slate-50. |
| `surface` | #ffffff | Cards, header, footer, the evidence panel, inputs, table rows. Alias of `white`. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-secondary`, `ink-muted`, `link`. `bg-surface`. Tailwind default: white. |
| `surface-sunken` | #e7e4e7 | Table header band, hovered rows, loading skeletons, the source chip at rest. Alias of `mist`. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-secondary` and `link`. Keep `ink-muted` off it (4.3:1). `bg-surface-sunken`. Tailwind default: slate-100. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--ink);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ink` | #0f172a | Primary text: values, criterion text, quotes, headings. 17.9:1 on `surface`; at least 14:1 on every tint in this system. Alias of `midnight`. `text-ink`. Tailwind default: slate-900. |
| `ink-secondary` | #475569 | Labels, metadata, column headers, the tagline, the footer. 7.6:1 on `surface`, 7.2:1 on `page`, 6.9:1 on `surface-sunken`. Alias of `graphite`. `text-ink-secondary`. Tailwind default: slate-600. |
| `ink-muted` | #64748b | Optional metadata only (timestamps, file sizes), on `surface` (4.8:1) or `page` (4.55:1). Never on `surface-sunken` (4.3:1) and never on a projector screen. Alias of `pewter`. `text-ink-muted`. Tailwind default: slate-500. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--white);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value */
```

### Tokens (55)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `white` | #ffffff | Main palette · cards and everything raised above the page ground. Used by `surface` (cards, header, footer, the evidence panel, inputs) and `action-ink` (the lettering of the main button). A background, not a text colour. Tailwind default: white. |
| `mist` | #e7e4e7 | Main palette · the sunken grey. Used by `surface-sunken`: table heads, hovered rows, loading skeletons, source chips at rest. Tailwind default: slate-100. |
| `fog` | #e2e8f0 | Main palette · hairlines. Used by `line` (card borders, table dividers) and `disabled-fill`. Tailwind default: slate-200. |
| `cloud` | #cbd5e1 | Main palette · the stronger rule that must survive a projector. Used by `line-strong`. Tailwind default: slate-300. |
| `pewter` | #64748b | Main palette · the mid grey. Used by `control` (edges of inputs, secondary buttons, chips, the drop zone), `ink-muted` and `disabled-ink`. As text, on `white` and `page` only: 4.8:1 and 4.55:1. As an edge it needs 3:1. Tailwind default: slate-500. |
| `graphite` | #475569 | Main palette · secondary text. Used by `ink-secondary` and `control-hover`. Text on `white`, `page`, `mist` and `ice`: 7.6, 7.2, 6.9 and 7.0:1. Tailwind default: slate-600. |

Text on `white`, `page`, `mist` and `ice`: 5.2, 4.9, 4.7 and 4.75:1; keep all four at 4.5:1 or more if you change it. Never a fill behind text, never a state. Tailwind default: blue-600. |

## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px. Inter, self-hosted, Latin + Cyrillic + Greek in one variable file. 14px is the floor. System monospace, no download needed.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-display);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `.display`, `--text-display` | 40px / 48px | 700 | `sans` | Landing hero and title slides only. `text-display`. |
| `title` | `.title`, `--text-title` | 28px / 36px | 700 | `sans` | Page titles: the patient on the case card, the trial on the criterion matrix. Same size as today. `text-title`. |
| `heading` | `.heading`, `--text-heading` | 20px / 28px | 600 | `sans` | Card and panel titles, the criterion in the evidence panel, empty-state headlines. `text-heading`. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 15px / 22px | 400 | `sans` | Default for everything else: field values, criterion text, table cells, buttons (with `font-semibold`). Same size as today. `text-body`. |
| `quote` | `.quote`, `--text-quote` | 16px / 26px | 400 | `sans` | Verbatim evidence quotes only, one step larger than body so evidence is the loudest text on screen. Keep the document's own language and punctuation. `text-quote`. |
| `small` | `.small`, `--text-small` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `sans` | The floor: pills, chips, badges, metadata, helper text, the footer. Nothing in Karma is smaller than 14px. `text-small`. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 14px / 20px | 600 | `sans` | Section labels and badge words, always set uppercase (`text-label uppercase`). Replaces today's 12px labels. |
| `trial-id` | `.trial-id`, `--text-trial-id` | 14px / 20px | 500 | `mono` | NCT IDs, in the monospace stack with tabular figures (`font-mono text-small font-medium`). Same treatment as today, at the 14px floor. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace` |

### Font files

Fonts: `tokens.css` loads each font from its file, by path.

- **Design canvas:** copy `tokens.css` and `fonts/Inter-Variable.woff2` to the same paths under the canvas’s `project/ds/<folder>/` (`<folder>` is the folder you install this system under; `fonts/Inter-Variable.woff2` lands on `project/ds/<folder>/fonts/Inter-Variable.woff2`), in the same call that installs this system. Link that copy of `tokens.css` in the artboard’s `<head>` as `ds/<folder>/tokens.css`, or as Design’s instructions say for an artboard in a folder. If the install’s reply leaves a font out, bring that font in as for any other page.
- **Slides deck:** for each family you use in the deck (`faces` holds at most the number of typefaces Slides’ `deck-files.md` gives), install its file with the system and name the path it lands on as that family’s `src` in `project/deck.json` `faces`, under the key in the Slides column. A deck takes a font as a file only under the rule in Slides’ `fonts.md` (no space or leading underscore in its path, for two): any other font, or one kept by id, is uploaded as `fonts.md` says.
- **Any other page:** one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`), upload it as an asset (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) and declare it with an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule.

`tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that links it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `faces` key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Inter | `fonts/Inter-Variable.woff2` (weight 100 900) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-sans)` | `inter` |

## Spacing

Tailwind's default 4px scale, unchanged: `space-4` is `p-4` is 16px.

### Use

```css
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (12)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `space-1` | 4px | Gap between a source chip's icon and its text; between stacked chips. `gap-1`, `p-1`. |
| `space-1.5` | 6px | Gap between a state icon and its word inside a pill; left padding of pills. `gap-1.5`, `pl-1.5`. |
| `space-2` | 8px | Gap between pills in a row, between chips, between a label and its input. `gap-2`. |
| `space-2.5` | 10px | Right padding of pills and badges. `pr-2.5`, `px-2.5`. |
| `space-3` | 12px | Input and small-button padding; vertical padding of table rows. `px-3`, `py-3`. |
| `space-4` | 16px | Button padding; cell padding; gap between field rows. `px-4`, `gap-4`. |
| `space-5` | 20px | Page side gutters (as today) and card padding. `px-5`, `p-5`. |
| `space-6` | 24px | Gap between case-card sections; evidence panel padding. `gap-6`, `p-6`. |
| `space-8` | 32px | Gap between page regions (case card and trial list). `gap-8`. |
| `space-10` | 40px | Top padding of a page below the header. `pt-10`. |
| `space-12` | 48px | Empty-state padding; landing sections. `py-12`. |
| `space-16` | 64px | Header height and title-slide margins. `h-16`. |

## Radius

Tailwind's default radii, unchanged: `radius-lg` is `rounded-lg`.

### Use

```css
/* var(--radius-md) */
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `radius-md` | 6px | Badges and source chips (as today). `rounded-md`. |
| `radius-lg` | 8px | Buttons, inputs, source tabs. `rounded-lg`. |
| `radius-xl` | 12px | Drop zone, the page-image frame, the expanded source list. `rounded-xl`. |
| `radius-2xl` | 16px | Cards (as today). `rounded-2xl`. |
| `radius-full` | 9999px | State pills, count pills, filter chips (as today). `rounded-full`. |

## Shadow

Flat. Three elevations, all slate-tinted.

### Use

```css
/* var(--shadow-card) */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `shadow-card` | 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05) | Cards at rest, if anything. The system is flat: a white card on `page` with a `line` border is enough. `shadow-card`. |
| `shadow-raised` | 0 4px 12px -2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08) | Things that float over content: the expanded source list, the stuck matrix header. `shadow-raised`. |
| `shadow-panel` | -16px 0 40px -16px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.28) | The evidence side panel, pinned to the right edge. `shadow-panel`. |

## Size

Fixed sizes and the layout grid.

### Use

```css
/* var(--size-icon-sm) */
```

### Tokens (11)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `size-icon-sm` | 16px | State icons in pills, chips and the legend. `size-4`. |
| `size-icon-md` | 20px | Icons in buttons, the drop zone and the evidence panel header. `size-5`. |
| `size-chip` | 24px | Source chip height: the WCAG 2.2 minimum target. `h-6`. |
| `size-pill` | 28px | State pill, count pill and badge height. `h-7`. |
| `size-control-sm` | 32px | Small buttons and filter chips. `h-8`. |
| `size-control-md` | 40px | Buttons and inputs. `h-10`. |
| `size-header` | 64px | App header height (as today). `h-16`. |
| `size-gutter` | 20px | Page side gutters (as today). `px-5`. |
| `size-content-max` | 1400px | Content column (as today). With the 20px gutters it stays inside a 1920px projector image at 125% browser zoom (1536 CSS px). `max-w-content`. |
| `size-panel` | 520px | Evidence side panel width. `w-panel`. |
| `size-text-floor` | 14px | The smallest text allowed anywhere, on screen and on the projector. `text-small`, `text-label`. |
